content: He who speaks without modesty will find it difficult to make his words good.
author: Confucius
explanation: Grand promises made in moments of vanity create insurmountable debts that reality will brutally call in. Restraint in speech preserves credibility and allows your deeds to exceed expectation.
practicalInsight: Refrain from declaring bold future claims publicly; let the quiet finished product surprise the world.
reflectionPrompt: Have you ever made a bold proclamation that you struggled to fulfill, and what did that teach you about restraint?
